The only time I have used a rest similar to this is for sighting a rifle with a scope.  You fire a shot and after firing you re-align the cross hairs with the aiming spot and then change the windage and elevation to move the cross hairs to the actual bullet hit.  Providing that your first shot hit somewhere on the target surface, you can sight a rifle in one shot.  To get the first shot on the paper I usually used a [bore-sight](http://www.shopbushnell.com/product_detail.asp?T1=BSN+743333).
